_comment: The language models VAULT agents use, in fallback order: every decision asks the first
provider; if it is slow, busy, out of quota or answers badly, the next one; if all fail,
the rule brain decides. Chosen with ModelBench on 2026-11-09 (see README).
Keys are NEVER written here: apiKeyEnv names the variable in the environment or the
git-ignored .env file. ${NAME} in a baseUrl is filled in from there too.
requestsPerMinute / requestsPerDay: free-tier limits to stay under (0 = none), set a little
below the published ones. Limits and model names change; check each provider's dashboard.
Groq's real limit is tokens: 8000 per minute per model on the free tier. One decision is about
1300 tokens, so about 6 a minute fit; requestsPerMinute 5 keeps it under, and the rest of a
turn's decisions go to the same model on Cloudflare.
To change anything, copy this file to the project folder as llm.json and edit that copy.
